title: Stable cursor pagination over identical timestamps
source: Authored for the CodeReview benchmark corpus (generation-v3 clean-authored stratum), 2026-11-05
false_flag_note: A reviewer might flag sorting on every call as wasteful, or returning a None cursor on an exactly-full final page. Sorting keeps the function correct for unsorted input without mutating it, and the contract defines None as 'this was the last page' -- determined by whether more items remain, not by page fullness -- so no phantom page is needed.
